method: Read-only ARM64 native disassembly plus full saved-corpus research decoding; no production codec execution, local tests, or native calls

fields.name: splitSequenceId
fields.meaning: One-based ordinal of this fragment in the ordered split of the source curve

fields.name: splitTotalNumber
fields.meaning: Number of fragments in that split of the source curve

evidence: NaFusion10:0x4b4dc0 ProfileTrackingHelper::updateSequenceId takes an AcGePoint3d, source Curve3D, ordered set<double> of intersection parameters, and multimap of sketch tags
0x4b4e3c queries isPeriodic; 0x4b4e40 reads the intersection-set size
0x4b4e50-0x4b4e58 and 0x4b4e64-0x4b4e68 emit (1,1) when no split is needed
0x4b4ef4 uses size-1 for open-curve fragment count; the periodic branch retains size
0x4b4f04 and 0x4b4fd8 increment the fragment ordinal while traversing ordered intervals
0x4b50e0 stores ordinal/count into sketch_tag_id+0x28/+0x2c and 0x4b5124 propagates the same pair to sibling tags
domain.caveat: The native assertions document intended producer invariants; raw restore reads two uint32 values without enforcing them. A semantic reader should enforce the producer invariant rather than silently normalizing malformed pairs.

matching.exactPairEquality: split_sequence_id::isEqualTo at NsASMInterface10:0xdc6a0 compares both uint32 fields
matching.compatibleMatch: split_sequence_id::match at NsASMInterface10:0xdc6cc accepts either pair(1,1), otherwise accepts equal sequence ordinals or two final fragments(sequence==total in both)
matching.sketchExactMatch: sketch_tag_id::exactMatch at0xde758-0xde760 calls compatible split match, so its name does not imply byte-identical split pairs

direction.evidence: NsASMInterface10::compareDirection 0xdc8bc and exactMatch0xde768-0xde784 test each operand with cmn w,#1, treating UINT32_MAX in either as compatible
direction.restriction: Do not narrow the persisted direction callback to a Boolean

secondaryTag.meaningEstablished: Second identifier in the source sketch CurveTag key, independent of split ordinal/count
secondaryTag.evidence: NaFusion10 ProfileMatcher::getSketchCurvesFromRecipe0x4b60d4 reads the adjacent primary/secondary uint64 pair from list-node+0x18/+0x20 at0x4b6114, then looks up map<Ns::Geometry::Sketch::CurveTag,...> at0x4b6120
secondaryTag.limitation: This study does not establish nonzero secondary-ID allocation semantics. Retaining the existing zero-qualified profile is supported by this corpus.
